component.name: Paper Lion
component.summary: Translate docs sites and app strings side by side

description.p: A translation workspace for Markdown documentation sites (Astro Starlight, VitePress) and interface strings (banana-i18n, gettext). The source is always beside the translation, and right-to-left languages work as well as left-to-right ones.
Files stay as they are in your project: Paper Lion changes only what you edit.
